proof:
# Exact obstruction to paying only at the left tilt endpoint

Consider independent unit exponentials with coefficients p=1, q=1/2, and forty identical negative coefficients -1/400. Put

    X=(400/401)^40, Y=(200/201)^40,
    F=2X-Y,
    mu_p=(40/401)/(1-Y/X)-1,
    D_-=2X-(401/201)Y.

These are exact actual quantities: F is the positive cap probability, mu_p is the conditional section mean at the larger positive coefficient, and D_- is the limit of (1-t)G(t) as t decreases to the allowed left tilt endpoint -400, where G=F_t(1-F_t)/product_i(1-t c_i).

The rational numbers above obey

    997/1000 < mu_p D_- / [F(1-F)] < 998/1000 < 1.

The companion exact Fraction verifier proves both inequalities by rational arithmetic, with no floating sign decision. Hence the proposed universal endpoint payment mu_p D_->=F(1-F) is false even within the actual two-positive phase family. The stronger supremum-over-all-tilts payment is not refuted: it is a different assertion and remains unproved.

The construction was suggested by many small negative phases whose sum approaches a positive constant. That limiting heuristic is not needed for the certificate; all coefficients and the finite phase count above are exact.
